Sri Lanka Women have some attacking players and their spin bowlers could easily exploit any weakness in the English batting. The onus will lie on their skipper Chamari Athapaththu, who could single-handedly turn the tie in Sri Lanka Women’s favor. The weather has been good in Birmingham, allowing all matches so far to be completed. We shall hope for the same here. Can England begin the tournament on a winning note? Or will Sri Lanka produce an upset to begin their campaign in style? Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
